question: In a circle with centre O and of radius 13 cm, two parallel chords are drawn on different sides of the centre. If the length of one chord is 10 cm and the distance between the two chords is 17 cm, then find the difference in lengths of the two chords (in cm).
solution:
**Given data:**

Radius = 13 cm

Length of one chord = 10 cm

Distance between chords = 17 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0acef48b7a2302a43178a951bf56a4d103b93317309a7bb32a951c2d3a7c59fc.png] 

BF = 1over 2 AB = 5 cm

Applying Pythagora's theorem in the Δ BOF 

BF² + OF² = BO²

⇒ OF2 = 13² - 5² = 12²

∴ OF = 12 cm.

⇒ OE = 17 - 12 = 5 cm

Applying Pythagora's theorem in Δ OED

⇒ ED2 + OE2 = OD2

⇒ ED2 = 132 - 52 = 122

∴ ED = 12 cm.

⇒ CD = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

Difference between the length of the chords = 24 - 10 = 14 cm

∴ **The difference between the length of the chords is 14 cm.**
